preconditions.description: The integer n is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and set(p) == set(range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: The input array p contains exactly n distinct integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (len(q) == n and set(q) == set(range(1, n + 1)) and all(q[q[i] - 1] == p[i] for i in range(n)))
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output is '-1'. Otherwise, output is a permutation q such that applying q twice (1-based indexing) yields p.
